fixture.exposure_policy: The exposure list is the only statement of which release each target contract answers, which later print that contract pays on, and how the two are joined. Each entry names the release whose information the contract answers, the contract, that contract's cohort for the release, the later print's outcome event, that print's reference period, its first publication instant, whether the fixture also packages that print as an event, and a basis text. The outcome event is always distinct from the release event. Every contract opens before the release it answers and keeps trading past that release plus the longest listed horizon, so the association is downstream and the payoff is unresolved at the release. The pairs are authored for this offline sample and estimate no transmission coefficient.
fixture.name: replay_sample
fixture.occurrence_id_policy: Occurrence identifiers are qualified with the sha256 of this file when it is read. The digest cannot be stored here, because a file cannot contain its own hash.
fixture.price_policy: Quotes and sizes are exact decimal literals and stay Decimal until the core panel conversion; no binary float appears in this file.

record_shape.book_event: kind snapshot carries bids/asks; kind delta carries side, price and, unless the operation is delete, a size
record_shape.timing: source_offset_seconds is measured from the event's scheduled instant; latency_seconds is the documented receipt delay after that source stamp, so usable time is the source stamp plus that latency

fixture.resolution_policy: No realized outcome is packaged: every target contract pays on a reference period later than the release whose information it answers, and that period's first print always falls after that release plus the longest listed panel horizon, so no target is resolved inside any measured window. Some of those later prints are themselves packaged illustrative releases carrying illustrative values, and the tail release of each family is paired with a print beyond the packaged calendar; in neither case does the sample record a target as resolved, and no resolution is packaged for any of them.
fixture.statement: Entirely synthetic illustrative records, authored for a deterministic offline replay sample. Every date, statistic, price and size is invented; none is observed BLS, market or venue data and none may be cited as such. Each of the ten packaged releases is paired, in the exposure list, with one target contract that pays on the next reference period's print of the same family, so every target is downstream of the release it answers and its payoff is unresolved when that release is published. The study's scientific cohort is configs/cohort.yaml, and no record here replaces one of its ten releases.
